facts.fact: GnetNews reports the Minister of Health saying, at the 10th Réalités forum on digital health, that digitisation of the medical record under the ministry's 'dossier médical unique' project had passed 95 per cent implementation; what the 95 per cent is a share of is not stated, and the capture is undated, so the record's proxy date of 2025 is used.

The Minister of Health said the next stage of the 'dossier médical unique' project would be to connect first-line health facilities to the internet and train their nurses and doctors, placing primary facilities ahead of the record rather than on it; no count of facilities is given, and the capture is undated (proxy date of 2025 used).
